note: The original description is by Banks 1918 (p. 662, alate); Emerson 1925 added the soldier from Kartabo material and gave a complete redescription; the content of this entry is taken from Emerson 1925. The original was extracted by OCR from an Internet Archive library scan.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, oval; fontanelle slit-like, fairly small. Antennal segment 2 slightly longer than segment 4 but less stout, segment 3 shorter than segment 4. Compound eyes of moderate size, not projecting, not very close to the lower margin of the head; ocelli small, separated from the compound eyes by about their width or slightly more. Postclypeus slightly paler than the head, the median line present but indistinct. Pronotum almost as dark as the head, sides rounded, posterior margin with only the slightest trace of a concavity, anterior corners rather pointed. Posterior margin of the mesonotum forming an angle much greater than a right angle, that of the metanotum about a right angle or slightly more. Abdominal tergites about concolorous with the pronotum. Measurements: head length 1.20—1.27 mm; head width 0.96—1.03 mm; compound eye diameter 0.27 mm; pronotum length 0.57 mm, width 0.90—0.93 mm; hind tibia length 1.00—1.03 mm; queen body length 13 mm, abdominal width 3 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head dark yellow, sparsely covered with long setae; sides straight and parallel, posterior margin slightly rounded, the anterior part of the head not wider than the posterior. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 equal to segment 4. Apex of the labrum deeply notched, the teeth pointed. Mandibles of the typical type, long and slender. Nasus rather short, falling far short of the tip of the labrum, its apex often (but not always) slightly upturned. Pronotum pale, anterior margin not concave. Legs pale. Abdominal tergites with fairly long hairs, only slightly shorter than the marginal setae; abdomen concolorous with the gut contents. Measurements: body length 6.50—7.00 mm; head length with nasus 1.54—1.70 mm; head width 1.09—1.16 mm; antennal length 2.40 mm; pronotum width 0.73 mm; hind tibia length 0.97—1.00 mm; left mandible length 2.15 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Very close to M. nigritus but slightly larger. Differences from M. saltans and M. nigritus: the latter two have a proportionally longer nasus, shorter mandibles and a smaller body. Type locality: Panama; new localities: Kartabo, Georgetown and others, British Guiana. Emerson noted that his specimens agreed with Banks's original description, except that the soldiers were smaller.
